release_notes: Strengthened DaVinci Resolve Free export validation, including portable package manifest and FCPXML media integrity checks.
Improved production completion, scheduling, publishing, rollback, and project-state recovery workflows.
Added project integrity checks with guarded safe repair, orphan recovery, and orphan deletion tools.
Improved Production, Media Library, Settings, project dialogs, and other interface workflows.
Expanded automated regression coverage and release-readiness checks.
